summary: Riskified Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Board authorized an additional $75 million share repurchase program (a 'distribution' under Israeli law) on June 4, 2026, supplementing an existing $375 million authorization of which ~$344.4 million had been used. The program is subject to completion of Israeli regulatory procedures, including a 30-day creditor objection period. Repurchases may be executed in open-market or private transactions under Rule 10b5-1, funded from cash reserves. No price or timing is specified. Watch: regulatory clearance timeline and pace of buyback execution as a signal of management's view on intrinsic value.
